groups.label: Funder
groups.description: Who the funder is and what they invest in.

groups.label: Contact
groups.description: The person you talk to and how warm the relationship is.

groups.label: Ask and terms
groups.description: What you ask for and the terms on the table.

groups.label: Process
groups.description: Where the deal stands and what you learned from it.

fields.label: Funder type
fields.description: What kind of funder this is, for filtering and for comparing similar funders.

options.label: Angel
options.description: A person who invests their own money.

options.label: Angel network
options.description: A group of individuals who review deals and invest together.

options.label: Venture fund
options.description: A professionally managed fund that invests other people's money in startups.

options.label: Corporate investor
options.description: A company, or its venture arm, that invests for strategic as well as financial reasons.

options.label: Bank or lender
options.description: A bank or another lender, including providers of revenue-based financing.

options.label: Public body
options.description: A government agency, public bank, region or city that offers funding.

options.label: Foundation
options.description: A foundation or nonprofit that gives grants or invests for its mission.

options.label: Crowdfunding platform
options.description: A platform where many people back you through rewards, pre-orders, shares or loans.

options.label: Customer
options.description: A customer who pays in advance, for example to fund a pilot.

options.label: Other
options.description: Any other source, such as a family office or friends and family.

fields.label: Thesis
fields.description: What they say they invest in, in their own words where possible, and how well you match it.
fields.example: e.g. Early software for small retailers; we match on sector, not yet on traction

fields.label: Stages
fields.description: The funding stages they invest at. Tick every stage they cover.

options.label: Pre-seed
options.description: The first outside money, often before a finished product or revenue.

options.label: Seed
options.description: Money to find product-market fit and early traction.

options.label: Series A
options.description: The first larger priced round, after clear traction.

options.label: Later
options.description: Series B and beyond, including growth rounds.

fields.label: Sectors
fields.description: The industries or technologies they focus on, and any they exclude.
fields.example: e.g. Climate and food; no crypto

fields.label: Geography
fields.description: Where the company or the founders must be for them to invest.

fields.label: Check size
fields.description: How much they usually put into one company, as a minimum and a maximum.

fields.label: Leads or follows
fields.description: Whether they lead rounds and set the terms, or only join rounds that someone else leads.

options.label: Leads
options.description: They set the terms and bring others in.

options.label: Follows
options.description: They invest only once another investor leads.

options.label: Both
options.description: They lead some rounds and follow in others.

options.label: Unknown
options.description: You checked, but they do not say.

fields.label: Portfolio conflicts
fields.description: Companies they back that compete with you or sit close to you. Check this before you share anything sensitive.
fields.example: e.g. Backs a direct competitor in the same market

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where you found the facts about this funder, such as their investment focus page or a public profile.

fields.label: Contact name
fields.description: The person you deal with at the funder, ideally one who can champion your deal inside it.

fields.label: Contact role
fields.description: Their title, so you know whether they can decide or must take your deal to others.

fields.label: Contact email
fields.description: Their direct email address, if they gave it to you.

fields.label: Introducer
fields.description: Who could introduce you to this funder, or who already did.

fields.label: Relationship
fields.description: How warm your connection to this funder is right now.

options.label: Cold
options.description: No connection yet; they do not know you.

options.label: Warm
options.description: You have an introduction or have been in touch, and they are open to talking.

options.label: Hot
options.description: Active talks, with clear interest on their side.

fields.label: Last contact date
fields.description: The last day you were in touch in either direction. Use it to time your next update or follow-up.

fields.label: Instrument
fields.description: How the money would come in. It decides which of the terms below apply.

options.label: Equity
options.description: You sell shares now at an agreed price or valuation.

options.label: SAFE or similar
options.description: A right to shares at a later priced round, which is not a loan.

options.label: Convertible note
options.description: A loan that turns into shares later, usually with interest and a maturity date.

options.label: Grant
options.description: Money you do not repay and that takes no shares.

options.label: Loan
options.description: Money you repay with interest.

options.label: Revenue-based financing
options.description: Money you repay as a share of your revenue until an agreed total is reached.

options.label: Crowdfunding
options.description: Money from many backers through a platform, as rewards, pre-orders, shares or loans.

options.label: Sponsorship
options.description: Money from a company in return for visibility or a relationship, not shares.

options.label: Prize
options.description: Money you win in a competition or challenge.

options.label: Other
options.description: Any other way of funding.

fields.label: Ask amount
fields.description: How much you are asking this funder for, not the size of the whole round.

fields.label: Valuation or cap
fields.description: The valuation of an equity round, or the valuation cap of a SAFE or note. Say in Other terms whether it is pre-money or post-money.

fields.label: Discount (%)
fields.description: The discount on the next round's share price when a SAFE or note converts.

fields.label: Interest rate (%)
fields.description: The yearly interest rate on a loan or a convertible note.

fields.label: Term (months)
fields.description: How many months until a loan must be repaid or a note matures.

fields.label: Dilution (%)
fields.description: Your best estimate of the share of the company you would give up in this deal.

fields.label: Board seat
fields.description: Whether the funder wants a seat on your board. Put observer seats and other control rights in Other terms.

fields.label: Other terms
fields.description: Any other term that matters, such as pro rata rights, a liquidation preference, repayment rules or grant conditions.
fields.example: e.g. Post-money cap; pro rata rights; observer seat

fields.label: Probability (%)
fields.description: Your own estimate of the chance this funder invests, from 0 to 100. Use it to weigh your pipeline, not as a fact.

fields.label: Expected close date
fields.description: When you expect the money to be committed or signed, if all goes well.

fields.label: Materials sent
fields.description: What you have shared with this funder so far, so you know what they have already seen.

options.label: Pitch deck
options.description: Your investor presentation.

options.label: One-pager
options.description: A one-page summary of the company.

options.label: Financial model
options.description: Your projections and the assumptions behind them.

options.label: Data room
options.description: Access to the folder of documents for due diligence.

options.label: Demo
options.description: A live or recorded demo of the product.

options.label: References
options.description: People who agreed to vouch for you, such as customers or investors.

fields.label: Due diligence
fields.description: How far the funder's checks on your company have gone.

options.label: Not started
options.description: They have not started checking your documents or references.

options.label: In progress
options.description: They are reviewing documents and asking questions.

options.label: Done
options.description: They have finished their checks.

fields.label: Term sheet date
fields.description: The day you received a term sheet or a written offer.

fields.label: Outcome reason
fields.description: Why it was won or lost, in their words if they gave reasons. Note whether and when to approach them again.
fields.example: e.g. Too early for them; revisit after a year of revenue

fields.label: Lessons learned
fields.description: What you would reuse or do differently with the next funder.
fields.example: e.g. Send the one-pager before the first call

activities.label: Commitments
activities.description: Each promise of money from this funder, recorded separately so you can see how much is verbal, written, conditional or signed.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: The amount promised, in the currency next to it.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: The three-letter currency code of the amount.

fields.label: State
fields.description: How firm the commitment is.

options.label: Verbal
options.description: Said in a call or meeting, with nothing in writing yet.

options.label: Written
options.description: Confirmed in an email or a message, but not in a signed agreement.

options.label: Conditional
options.description: Promised on a condition, such as another investor joining or a milestone being met.

options.label: Signed
options.description: Covered by a signed agreement.

fields.label: Instrument
fields.description: How this commitment comes in. Leave it empty when it matches the instrument in Ask and terms.

options.label: Equity
options.description: You sell shares now at an agreed price or valuation.

options.label: SAFE or similar
options.description: A right to shares at a later priced round, which is not a loan.

options.label: Convertible note
options.description: A loan that turns into shares later, usually with interest and a maturity date.

options.label: Grant
options.description: Money you do not repay and that takes no shares.

options.label: Loan
options.description: Money you repay with interest.

options.label: Revenue-based financing
options.description: Money you repay as a share of your revenue until an agreed total is reached.

options.label: Crowdfunding
options.description: Money from many backers through a platform, as rewards, pre-orders, shares or loans.

options.label: Sponsorship
options.description: Money from a company in return for visibility or a relationship, not shares.

options.label: Prize
options.description: Money you win in a competition or challenge.

options.label: Other
options.description: Any other way of funding.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day the commitment was made or reached its current state. It shows on the calendar.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Conditions, names or anything else about this commitment.

activities.label: Payments
activities.description: Money due or received from this funder, one row per payment or tranche. Update the status as it moves from expected to received.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: The amount of this payment, in the currency next to it.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: The three-letter currency code of the amount.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Where this payment stands.

options.label: Expected
options.description: Agreed or likely, but no payment date is set yet.

options.label: Scheduled
options.description: A payment date is set.

options.label: Invoiced
options.description: You have sent an invoice or a payment request.

options.label: Partially received
options.description: Part of the amount has arrived.

options.label: Received
options.description: The full amount has arrived.

options.label: Delayed
options.description: It is late, or the date has moved.

options.label: Cancelled
options.description: It will not be paid.

fields.label: Due date
fields.description: When the payment is due or expected. It shows on the calendar.

fields.label: Received date
fields.description: The day the money arrived in your account.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: The invoice number, transfer reference or contract clause that identifies this payment.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Anything else about this payment, such as a condition for releasing it.
